evaluation: Fresh screening and autonomous metadata-based acquisition; no evaluator-supplied PDFs. Frozen search reused.

errors.error: Fewer than two validated independent effects

limitations: Single accessible bibliographic database; no claim of historical multi-database search equivalence.
No model-independent guarantee against training-data contamination.
Only independent parallel continuous outcomes with reported SDs; no imputation.

reference.notes: Article abstract labels SMD with mmol/L and figure captions call effects weighted mean differences. Frozen primary comparison follows abstract SMD. This inconsistency is a scientific uncertainty, not a tuning opportunity.
reference.identity_note: Twelve reports cited as included in the review (references 23–34); not asserted to be twelve independent trials, or all nine FBG contributors.

screening_repeatability.comparison: Repeated development screening; no label correction or target-driven tuning
